name: The Ultimate Fighter 22: Team McGregor vs. Team Faber

_provenance.note: The finale bout is reconciled against our own ufc_bouts / ufc_bout_results records and is NOT imported: we already hold that card. Everything inside the house exists only here.

_conflicts.detail: The source's second-round table lists nine bouts where a round of sixteen should produce eight, and one of them — Ryan Hall def. Frantz Slioa — repeats a bout already listed in the elimination round. Frantz Slioa cannot both lose that bout and win his own entry bout against Martin Delaney in the same round. The eight internally consistent bouts are recorded; the repeated Hall v Slioa entry is recorded separately as disputed and is NOT counted as a result.

No source consulted states whether the in-house bouts of this season were sanctioned. They are recorded as exhibitions on the strength of the tournament being filmed at the TUF Gym outside a commission-sanctioned card, and that reasoning is carried on every bout rather than applied as a blanket rule. Any bout whose status cannot be established that way is 'unverified'.

roster.name: Martin Svensson
roster.note: Withdrew from the tournament with a broken elbow.

roster.name: Saul Rogers
roster.note: Reached the final and was then pulled from the card over his visa application.

roster.name: Artem Lobov
roster.note: Lost his entry bout to Mehdi Baghdad and was brought back into the tournament.

roster.name: Chris Gruetzemacher
roster.note: Entered the quarter-finals as a replacement for Martin Svensson.

roster.name: Ryan Hall
roster.note: Lost in the quarter-finals, then replaced Saul Rogers in the final and won the tournament.

roster.name: Johnny Nuñez
roster.note: Brought back into the tournament after an earlier elimination.
